text: Independent domain review found that raw mesh PointField exposed an unsupported millimetre claim and a singleton chart across unrelated meshes. Local follow-up 8c1de2757 (secondary isolated worktree, parent 529526e3d) makes points private[surface], uses an uninterpreted custom quantity/unit without canonical scale, and creates a fresh ephemeral frame per field. Added external visibility, non-alignment and explicit metre FramedSurface transport regressions. Both surface platform gates running; primary frozen 1cb288d5f full matrix remains untouched. No publication.
